requirements.title: REST API for Team CRUD
requirements.description: Implement REST API endpoints for creating, reading, updating and deleting teams with JSON payload support

validation.notes: All team CRUD endpoints return correct HTTP status codes

requirements.title: Team Roles Management
requirements.description: Team roles management with role definitions

validation.notes: Roles can be defined and stored on the team
Roles are persisted and returned with team data
Org chart edges stored and retrieved correctly

requirements.title: Verified creator and governed finite draft amendments
requirements.description: Record server-verified team creation identity; amend only a disabled undispatched finite draft through its current creator with write authority or an exact approved owner operation, preserving CAS, audit, grants and reservation fences.

validation.notes: Creator/legacy object authority, expiration, lifecycle denial, concurrency, atomic restart projection and attribution preservation. Status is earned through owner validation sync.
Actual generated Connect wire path preserves verified actor and denied request semantics.
Bounded exact amendment input and no false owner confirmation.
Closed ingress boundary denies every generated non-preparation team/heartbeat procedure, unrelated and unknown routes, for both interactive grants and request authorities before handler side effects.
Generated Connect read admits approved team, refuses another existing team before disclosure.
Approved CLI identity may use only exact GET health bootstrap routes with read capability; health mutations and unrelated reads remain denied.
